claims: The 2026 Men's Final Four games are scheduled for Saturday, April 4.
The 2026 National Championship is scheduled for Monday, April 6.
The 2026 Men's Final Four games will be broadcast on TBS and truTV.
The 2026 National Championship will be broadcast on TBS and truTV.
Coverage for the semifinal games starts at 6:00 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 4th.
The 2026 Final Four is scheduled in Indianapolis on April 4.
2026 Final Four Game 1 is scheduled for 6:09 p.m. ET on TBS/truTV.
2026 Final Four Game 2 is scheduled for ~8:30 p.m. ET on TBS/truTV.
Streaming services for the 2026 Final Four include Max (formerly HBO Max), Sling TV, DIRECTV Stream, Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV.
The NCAA March Madness Live app is a digital option for the 2026 Final Four.
In 2026, Turner Sports (TBS/truTV) holds the rights to the Final Four rather than CBS, as part of their alternating agreement.
